title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-tkjl: test vectors JSON stale — format_version mismatch
description:
P1: The test vectors JSON at `test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json` still contains wire bytes in the old format (`0x7c`, `0x7a`, etc.) while the code now produces new-format wire bytes (`0x3e`, `0x3d`, etc.). 

The `shared_vectors_drive_production_implementations` test in `fragmentation_vectors.rs` fails:


The code asserts `format_version: 2` and the JSON has `format_version: 2`, but the wire bytes in the JSON were never regenerated to match the new interleaved format. The JSON vectors must be regenerated from independent oracles and committed.
